comments.author: Trout
comments.body_html: For those who still want to use this mod with 3.9, open package.json with a text editor and replace “akiVersion”: “~3.8”, with “sptVersion”: “3.9”,. It should work with most of the headsets, but looking at the code it doesn’t seem too hard to add the rest.
